meta.title: The Bigfoot Campout
meta.teaser: Follow giant footprints and discover who is hiding in the woods!

text: You are camping with Dad under the stars.
The fire crackles. Marshmallows are toasting.
Something TALL moves behind the bushes!

commands.response: Dad whispers: I saw it too! Grab the lantern and pack a snack. Then we go look.
Dad is holding a marshmallow stick like a sword. Very brave.
The bushes shake again. Whatever is there is REALLY tall!
Two big furry legs hurry away into the forest!
The lantern is already in your hand, glowing bright.
You grab the lantern. Click! A warm yellow light.
A camping lantern. The forest is dark, so you will need it.
Your snack is already in your pocket.
You tuck a crunchy granola snack into your pocket.
A crunchy granola snack. Good food for a hike. Or for sharing!
You already have Dad's camera around your neck.
You hang Dad's camera around your neck. Say cheese!
Dad's camera. If you see something amazing, you could take a picture!
You and Dad switch on the lantern and follow the sound into the trees.
Dad says: It is dark out there. Take the LANTERN first!
Dad says: Explorers get hungry. Pack a SNACK first!
Dad says: Not so fast! We need the LANTERN and a SNACK.
Dad says: Wait! First find out what moved in the bushes.
You and Dad push past the bushes and follow the furry stranger.
Dad says: It is dark out there. Take the LANTERN first!
Dad says: Explorers get hungry. Pack a SNACK first!
Dad says: Not so fast! We need the LANTERN and a SNACK.
Dad says: Look before you leap into a bush!
You stand next to Dad. He puts a hand on your shoulder. Ready?

default: A cricket chirps. That did not help.
The campfire pops like it is laughing.
Something in the woods goes CRUNCH!
Dad checks the marshmallows and waits for you.
An owl hoots far away.
Try looking at the bushes.
hints: Something moved in the bushes. Dad might have advice.
LOOK at the BUSHES and pack the LANTERN and SNACK. The CAMERA is optional.
LOOK BUSHES, TAKE LANTERN, TAKE SNACK, then GO FOREST.

text: At the forest edge, your lantern lights up ENORMOUS footprints.
Each one is longer than your whole shoe.
Dad gulps. You grin.

commands.response: Five giant toes point deeper into the forest.
The muddy tracks are fresh. One has FIVE giant toes!
A tuft of brown fur is caught on the bark, way up high. Whatever it is, it is TALL.
Dad whispers: Follow the tracks, but stay close to me.
Dad is measuring a footprint with his hand. It takes three hands.
You follow the giant tracks between the trees. Dad stays close.
Which way did it go? The ground might hold a clue.
You follow the giant tracks between the trees. Dad stays close.
Take a good LOOK at the tracks first. Which way do the toes point?
Only ferns and berries here. The tracks are more interesting.
You whisper hello. A squirrel chatters back. Rude!
You say hi to a footprint. It does not say hi back.
Your snack is safe in your pocket.
The lantern makes long, wiggly shadows.
You snap a photo of a footprint. Dad says: Nice one!

default: An owl hoots: Who? Who?
A twig snaps somewhere ahead.
The trees rustle in the night breeze.
Your lantern makes long, wiggly shadows.
Dad hums to stay brave.
Maybe the huge footprints are a clue.
hints: The ground has a very large clue.
LOOK at the TRACKS before going on.
Use LOOK TRACKS, then GO FOREST.

text: A giant fallen log blocks the trail.
The footprints go right OVER it.
Inside the hollow log, something glitters.

commands.response: The log is hollow. A shiny pinecone sits inside, as big as your head!
You pull. The log does not move one bit. It is a LOG.
You already have the giant pinecone.
You reach into the log and pull out a huge, shiny pinecone!
The biggest pinecone you have ever seen. Someone left it here on purpose.
The tracks stop at the log and start again on the other side. It stepped right over!
Dad gives you a boost. You scramble over the log and he climbs after you.
You walk up to the log. It is taller than you. You will have to CLIMB.
The log is in the way. CLIMB over it!
The tracks go over the log. So must you!
Dad says: I can give you a boost. Want to climb over?
Dad is sniffing the air. He smells like marshmallow.
You cannot climb a footprint. Try the LOG.
Still crunchy. Still in your pocket.
The lantern light shines into the hollow log.
You take a picture of the log. Dad says it looks like a giant hot dog.

default: The log is quiet. Logs usually are.
A beetle marches across the bark.
Something hoots softly, far away.
Dad taps the log. THUNK.
The glitter inside the log winks at you.
hints: The trail does not stop here. Neither should you.
CLIMB the LOG to keep following the tracks.
Use CLIMB LOG. (LOOK LOG first if you want a surprise!)

text: You and Dad reach a moonlit creek.
The water is cold and fast.
Across the creek, the bushes sneeze: AH-CHOO!

commands.response: Too deep to wade. But three flat stones poke out of the water.
Three flat stones make a path across. Hop, hop, hop!
Hop! Hop! HOP! You and Dad cross the creek on the stones. The bushes tremble.
Brrr! The water is too deep and too cold. Find a dry way across.
They are on the other side of the water. Cross the creek first.
The bushes across the creek shake. Something big is hiding there.
You call: BLESS YOU! A deep, soft voice says: Thank you.
The giant tracks cross the creek and end at the bushes.
Dad whispers: Did the bushes just say thank you?
Dad is holding the lantern high. His eyes are very wide.
You talk to the creek. It just burbles.
Your snack is a little squished. Still tasty.
The lantern light sparkles on the water.
The giant pinecone is heavy, but you are not leaving it behind.
You snap the moonlit creek. Beautiful!

default: AH-CHOO! The bushes sneeze again.
A frog splashes into the creek.
Moonlight dances on the water.
That makes the hidden stranger giggle.
Dad shivers. It is chilly here.
Those stones look useful.
hints: Something in the water could help you cross.
LOOK at the CREEK or the STONES.
Use GO STONES to hop across.

text: A berry patch glows in the moonlight.
A HUGE furry shape is picking berries.
It has not seen you yet.

commands.response: Bigfoot is calm now. He munches a berry and watches you back.
It is BIGFOOT! He freezes. You stay very still. Slowly, he relaxes.
You say a soft hello. Bigfoot hoots back, gently.
You shout HELLO! Bigfoot jumps and hides behind a bush. Too loud! Try a quiet LOOK first.
You and Dad step slowly into the moonlight. Bigfoot steps forward too.
He looks ready to run. Stay still and LOOK first.
You already picked a handful of berries.
You pick a handful of juicy berries. Bigfoot notices, and nods.
Fat purple berries. Bigfoot's favourite, by the look of it.
The bushes are stripped of berries up high. Someone tall has been snacking.
Dad whispers: Stay calm. Be friendly. And do not shout.
Dad's mouth is open. He cannot believe it either.
Take Bigfoot? He is MUCH bigger than you. Nope.
You tiptoe to the bushes. Bigfoot is right there! Maybe LOOK at him.
Your snack smells extra tasty after the hike. Bigfoot sniffs the air.
You lower the lantern so it does not shine in Bigfoot's eyes.
Bigfoot glances at your giant pinecone. Does he recognize it?
Not yet. He might run if the camera flashes.

default: Bigfoot picks another berry. Munch, munch.
A berry drops on your head. Plop!
Dad holds his breath.
The leaves rustle softly.
Bigfoot's ears twitch. Be careful.
hints: Stay calm and quiet. Do not scare him.
LOOK at BIGFOOT quietly, then TALK to him softly.
Use LOOK BIGFOOT, then GO BIGFOOT to meet him.

text: You, Dad, and Bigfoot stand together in the moonlight.
He looks hungry and keeps glancing at your pocket.
LOOK and TALK to Bigfoot let you stay.
A snack, photo, goodbye JOKE, or leaving will end this visit.

commands.response: Bigfoot's eyes light up. He gently takes the snack. CRUNCH!
You hold out the snack. Bigfoot's eyes light up and he gently takes it.
You hand Bigfoot your snack. His eyes light up as he gently takes it.
Bigfoot tilts his head. Give him what? Your pockets are empty.
You lift the camera. Bigfoot strikes a pose. CLICK! FLASH!
Bigfoot does not want the camera. But he might like to be IN a picture.
Bigfoot shakes his head. He has eaten SO many berries. He wants something crunchy.
Bigfoot pats his full belly. No more berries, thanks! Something crunchy?
Bigfoot grins and juggles your pinecone! Then he hands it back. His favourite toy.
Bigfoot juggles the pinecone three times, then gives it back. He wants you to keep it.
Bigfoot is still waiting. His stomach rumbles: GRRRUMBLE!
Bigfoot is taller than Dad! His fur is brown and fluffy. He waves, then eyes your pocket.
You try a silly Bigfoot goodbye: MY SOCKS TASTE LIKE PINECONES! Bigfoot bursts out laughing.
A silly goodbye in Bigfoot language. TELL JOKE ends your visit with a laugh.
Bigfoot hoots about his forest home. He is happy to keep chatting.
You say hello. Bigfoot hoots softly. Keep chatting, or TELL JOKE for a silly goodbye that ends your visit.
Dad whispers: He looks hungry. Do you have anything to share?
Dad is smiling the biggest smile you have ever seen.
The forest is Bigfoot's home. GO FOREST lets him go home and ends your visit quietly.
You step back and point to the forest. Bigfoot nods, waves, and slips away quietly.
Your camera is already here. For a photo ending, use CAMERA BIGFOOT.
GO CAMP leaves to fetch a camera and ends this visit. Bigfoot might not wait.
You have the camera right here! Why go back?
You and Dad hurry back to camp to get the camera.
You take one step closer. Bigfoot takes one step back. Easy now.
Bigfoot looks at your snack, then politely looks away. He is too shy to ask.
You keep the lantern low. Bigfoot blinks slowly. He likes that.
The camera is ready. Bigfoot might even pose!

default: Bigfoot blinks and waits.
His giant stomach rumbles: GRRRRUMBLE!
A moth circles your lantern.
Bigfoot scratches his fuzzy chin.
That is not quite how you greet a forest giant.
Choose carefully. Bigfoot is watching you.
hints: LOOK and TALK to BIGFOOT are safe. Choose how to end your visit when you are ready.
GIVE SNACK ends as friends. With a CAMERA, CAMERA BIGFOOT takes a goodbye photo.
TELL JOKE ends with a laugh. GO FOREST lets Bigfoot go. Without a CAMERA, GO CAMP leaves to fetch it.

text: Bigfoot shares the snack with you and Dad.
Then he leads you to his secret berry patch and a hidden waterfall.
At sunrise, he walks you back to camp and gives you a fist bump.
You have a friend in the forest now.

commands.response: Bigfoot whispers: Same camp next summer? You say YES!
Your new friend smiles a huge, fuzzy smile.
Bigfoot knows every berry bush and every animal trail.
The fire is still warm. Dad makes Bigfoot a marshmallow. He eats twelve.
Dad says: Best. Camping trip. EVER.
Dad is teaching Bigfoot a secret handshake. It takes a while.
Bigfoot taps your pinecone and nods. It was a gift all along.
Bigfoot poses with you and Dad. CLICK! Best photo ever.

default: Bigfoot gives you a careful fist bump.
This is the best camping trip ever!
Your new friend makes a happy hooting sound.
The sun comes up gold and pink.

text: You watch quietly as Bigfoot crosses the creek and melts into the trees.
Back at camp, you and Dad promise to leave his home peaceful.
You draw one enormous footprint in your notebook.
Your shy forest friend deserves a quiet home.

commands.response: He is gone, but you will always remember his little wave.
By morning, the creek has washed the giant tracks away.
For just a moment, a huge hand waves between the trees.
Dad says: We can tell our family about tonight and let Bigfoot enjoy his quiet home.
Dad keeps looking at the trees and smiling.
You whisper goodbye. A soft hoot answers.
You still have your snack for tomorrow's hike.
The giant pinecone sits by your tent. Proof, if you ever need it.

default: Bigfoot's forest home is peaceful again.
The forest is peaceful again.
What an amazing camping night!

text: You meant to say GOODBYE in Bigfoot language.
Instead you said: MY SOCKS TASTE LIKE PINECONES!
Bigfoot laughs so hard that owls fly out of the trees.
Before he heads home, you and Dad laugh with him.

commands.response: Bigfoot repeats your mixed-up greeting. Now Dad is laughing too.
He points at your socks, then pretends to nibble a pinecone.
Back at camp, you and Dad practice the real Bigfoot word for hello. It is HOOT.
Dad says: Pinecone socks! I am never going to forget that.
Dad wipes away a laughing tear.
You still have your snack. Bigfoot is too busy laughing to notice.
You look at the pinecone. You look at your socks. Nope. Different.

default: Bigfoot is still chuckling.
Bigfoot language is harder than it sounds!
Next time, you will practice the goodbye first.

text: When you and Dad get back with the camera, Bigfoot is gone.
All you find is one giant footprint and a tuft of brown fur.
Dad takes a picture of the footprint anyway.
Maybe next summer.

commands.response: The footprint is real. Dad says it is bigger than a dinner plate!
Two bushes shake far away, then everything is still.
You call hello, but only an owl answers.
You and Dad spend the morning wondering what might have happened.
Dad says: Next time, we bring the camera from the start.
Dad is a little sad, but mostly amazed.
Maybe Bigfoot would have liked this snack.
The pinecone is all you have to remember him by.

default: Maybe you will see Bigfoot next time.
The forest keeps its mystery.
Dad takes another picture of the footprint.

text: CLICK! FLASH! Bigfoot blinks, waves, and hurries off into the dark.
Back at camp, you look at the picture.
It is a big brown BLUR with two shiny eyes.
Dad says it is the best blurry photo in the world.

commands.response: A brown blur with two shiny eyes. And maybe a thumbs up?
Dad says: Everyone will say it is a bear. We know better.
Dad has already made the blur his phone background.
Somewhere out there, Bigfoot is rubbing his eyes. Sorry about the flash!
You call out: THANK YOU FOR THE PICTURE! A faraway hoot says you are welcome.
Camp is quiet. Your picture is not.
You never gave him the snack. Next time.
You put the pinecone next to the photo. Nobody will believe this.

default: The blurry photo is still blurry.
Dad giggles every time he looks at it.
Somewhere, Bigfoot is still blinking.
